decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of control elements and powerful elemental creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The elemental creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef provide a strong board presence and synergy with the rest of the deck. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to the necessary resources for success.

The primary strategy of this deck is to efficiently ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Azusa, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, in order to quickly cast Primeval Titan and start doubling your land drops with Amulet of Vigor. This allows you to search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and bounce lands to generate massive amounts of mana and trigger powerful landfall abilities. The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet Titan combo to overwhelm your opponent with powerful land-based threats and game-winning combos.

The deck focuses on casting cheap spells to cascade into bigger threats, overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By using cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can quickly generate value and put pressure on the opponent. Utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower for removal and disruption, the deck aims to maintain tempo while gradually building up to casting spells like Crashing Footfalls for a big board presence. With a mix of efficient creatures and versatile spells, the deck aims to win through quick aggression and overwhelming board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the game. It also utilizes card draw and selection tools like Consider and Expressive Iteration to maintain consistency. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Unholy Heat adds flexibility and disruption to the strategy. The mana base is optimized for speed and consistency, allowing the deck to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

The main concept of this combo-driven Hammer Time deck is to assemble powerful equipment, such as Colossus Hammer and Cranial Plating, onto efficiently-costed creatures like Ornithopter and Memnite to quickly close out games with massive damage early on. With cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to help tutor and equip the pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy while utilizing cards like Esper Sentinel for card advantage and disruption. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga to further support its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with powerful Elemental creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude, while also using Elemental synergies with Risen Reef and Flamekin Harbinger. It includes protection with Unsettled Mariner and Voice of Resurgence, along with recursion effects like Ephemerate. The deck utilizes a variety of lands to ensure color fixing and mana consistency. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility to the deck.

This deck focuses on assembling a quick and powerful combo using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. The key strategy involves tutoring for the necessary pieces with Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift while protecting your creatures with cards like Giver of Runes. The deck's efficiency comes from low-cost creatures like Memnite and Ornithopter alongside cards like Sigarda's Aid to cheat equipment into play. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its explosive and aggressive playstyle.

The focus of this deck is to efficiently cycle through your deck to get key creatures into your graveyard, using cards like Architects of Will and Street Wraith. Once you have filled your graveyard with creatures, you can cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming your opponent with a powerful board presence. Cards like Force of Negation and Violent Outburst help protect your combo and ensure it resolves successfully. With the right setup, this deck can quickly take control of the game and secure a victory.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 deck is to utilize a combination of creatures and spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies, while setting up for a powerful finish with Living End. The deck focuses on cycling through cards, disrupting the opponent's hand, and finally casting Living End to bring back a board full of powerful creatures from the graveyard. By combining these elements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through a well-timed Living End activation.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. This UR Aggro deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent with efficient and versatile creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck utilizes cantrips like Consider and Expressive Iteration to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage. With a mix of burn spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures, this deck seeks to apply early pressure and control the game until victory is achieved.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize the combo between Throes of Chaos and Calibrated Blast to cycle through the deck and generate a powerful board presence quickly. By ramping into big creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, Autochthon Wurm, and Scion of Draco, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats. The land base is optimized to support the combo potential and ensure a consistent mana base for casting the spells needed to execute the game plan effectively.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful combo pieces such as Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor. Using land tutors like Tolaria West and Expedition Map, along with bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber and Gruul Turf, allows for explosive plays. Utilizing the unique abilities of lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Urza's Saga further enhances the deck's potential. The goal is to assemble the Amulet Titan combo as quickly as possible to overpower the opponent and win the game.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be sacrificed and used to tutor for specific cards from the deck. By utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, Chord of Calling, and Eldritch Evolution, players can quickly find and play powerful combo pieces like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Geralf's Messenger. The deck aims to create a synergistic toolbox of creatures that can be sacrificed and recycled to generate value and overwhelm opponents with a quick and efficient combo strategy.

This deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo utilizing Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip Colossus Hammer for free and swing for lethal damage with a massive creature. The deck also includes various equipment tutors and protection cards to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a massive, unblockable threat.

This deck aims to quickly assemble Colossus Hammer onto a creature equipped with Sigarda's Aid or Stoneforge Mystic, allowing for a powerful, fast attack. The inclusion of Inkmoth Nexus also provides an alternative win condition by dealing infect damage. The deck has a low mana curve, enabling it to consistently play threats and protect them with counterspells like Spell Pierce. Urza's Saga is a key card that can search for key pieces like Colossus Hammer or The Reality Chip, providing additional consistency to the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures onto the battlefield using lands that generate extra mana. It also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void to control the opponent's resources. Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Ineffable provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats like Reality Smasher and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger while efficiently controlling the board with removal spells like Dismember. It also includes a strong mana base with Urza lands and Eldrazi Temple to support its aggressive game plan.
